attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Image 1 is the exact original game portrait-card asset and sole authority for composition, clothing, pose and lighting; Image 2 is user mascot identity only. Produce ONE independent high-resolution 65:67 portrait card. The exact original has a slightly tilted dark rectangular photo frame, opaque grey backing, and overlapping cream lower-right note with faint short multirow strokes. Retain their silhouette, overlap and lighting.
Actually observed visible features: Elderly bust turned toward image-left. Brown/olive garrison side cap with diagonal folded top and thin gold piping, small indistinct metallic decoration footprint; grey short temple hair, grey eyebrows, stern closed mouth and clean-shaven face, no visible glasses. Dark olive/brown open military jacket over light khaki shirt collar and darker tie. Retain actual cap silhouette and crop, source light/shadows and original open lapels. Keep smooth upper lip and chin with NO added moustache or beard.
SOURCE DIRECTION AND GARMENT STYLE ARE MANDATORY: keep the actual forward/right/left view described above, closed/open collar, lapels and fasteners; do not default every mascot to a left-facing pose. Retain every visible eyebrow as actual colored HAIR, not just socket shading.
Replace the depicted human anatomy with the reference mascot: smooth warm golden-yellow body, compact rounded head, green-ringed black eyes and simple mascot mouth. Preserve the source-visible hairstyle, hairline, eyebrow HAIR and facial hair exactly where actually present; keep original head direction, gaze, closed-mouth expression and all clothing/accessories. Do not infer details from a person name, filename or biography. A clean-shaven source stays clean-shaven; no added beard, glasses, hat, people, symbols or decorations.
The round chin meets the existing neckline through a VERY SHORT BROAD neck transition. Refit collar and shoulders to that body shape while preserving original garment style, fastening and overlap. No long narrow yellow neck, floating collar, clipping, neck rolls or cream belly patch at the collar. The mascot reference full-body pose and bare scalp do not replace the original card crop, clothes or hair.
Retain the FULL dark photo frame, opaque painted/photo backing, cream overlapping note, shadows and every solid surface. Preserve the upper-note faint short marks at the original position/footprint/contrast as indistinct strokes; add no readable writing and do not erase the note. Preserve genuine transparency only OUTSIDE the entire complete frame-and-note silhouette; no internal transparent holes or faded face, hair, collar or clothing. Painterly game portrait finish; one asset only, no comparison sheet, new label, text or watermark.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actual source/full-master comparison: olive garrison cap, gold piping and small decoration footprint, olive open jacket/khaki shirt/darker tie, image-left turn, frame, opaque backing and overlapping note are retained. Clearly visible light grey source eyebrow and temple hair has been omitted; the returned face is browless and bare at both cap-side areas. Short broad collar fit remains coherent and white/cyan/alpha views show exterior-only transparency without internal holes. Restore the actual visible hair with a separate built-in repair while keeping the source clean-shaven and preserving cap, outfit and pose.
